button.label: Set selected
button.supertip: Put one value into every selected cell - a window shows how many will change and how many are refused before anything is written. On coolant cells: tick boxes for the coolants.

button.label: Scale %
button.supertip: Multiply the selected numbers by a percentage (110 = 10% more), with a preview of the new values.

button.label: Copy from op
button.supertip: Copy one operation's values into the selected rows, for the selected columns - pick the operation from a list.

button.label: Selected cells
button.supertip: Put the selected cells back to their dumped values.

button.label: Selected rows
button.supertip: Put every cell of the selected rows back to its dumped value.

button.label: Everything
button.supertip: Put the whole sheet back to the dump.

button.label: List changes
button.supertip: A Changes sheet listing every cell that differs from the dump, old and new.

button.label: Speed / feed
button.supertip: A live calculator: diameter and SFM to RPM and back, feed per rev to per minute. Filled from the row you are on; warns past max_ss.

button.label: Coolants
button.supertip: Tick boxes for the coolants at one timing - click a coolant_before / with / after cell first (or select several and use Set selected).

button.label: Manual text
button.supertip: A big editor for a manual entry's text, with a live character count - click a manual_text cell first (or double-click it).
